subject: [video] R1 follow-up: final counts after two more checks (R1 PASS 401/401)
body:
Small correction to my DONE message, after commit e0905b6 (which also follows 024d18e; 18bbb4b is the main one):
- jpeg suite is now N2TEST R1 PASS 401/401 (162 unit checks x2 configurations + 77 oracle checks). The extra check is segment ownership: n2jpeg_open() copies the APPn/COM payloads, and the test frees the caller's heap payload before the encode and still finds the exact bytes in the file.
- The VT suite is unchanged: N2TEST R1-vt PASS 343/343. Its test-side n2vt_say sink is now mutex-protected, because two encoders on two threads both log the 'CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate is absent' line under TSan; TSan is clean again.
- STATUS.md and jpeg/STATUS.json carry the new numbers.
Everything else in the DONE message stands: never run on the phone, CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreate branch unexercised on the host, baseline-only, and the full build_ios link still blocked by avc/kern symbols (not R1's).
